summary: The gyomu-ai package provides a robust AI integration and execution framework built primarily around Pydantic AI. It manages runtime execution contexts, parameters, policies, tools, and error handling, while offering seamless mapping between provider-specific constructs and standardized AI generation, streaming, and embedding results.
responsibilities: Integrate Pydantic AI functionality including model registries, agent creation, prompt building, and execution.
Manage execution context, runtime parameters, configuration policies, observers, and result structures for AI interactions.
Define classes and types for AI tool execution, configuration, and public error handling.
Define and handle application-specific routing and operation errors.
Represent core AI model structures and keys used across the application.

capabilities.name: Pydantic AI Integration
capabilities.description: Integration layer mapping Pydantic AI models, agents, tools, prompts, and results to standard internal formats.

capabilities.name: Execution Environment
capabilities.description: Management of execution context, runtime parameters, configuration policies, observers, and result structures for AI operations.

capabilities.name: AI Tool Execution
capabilities.description: Core domain logic and definitions for AI tool execution, configurations, and public error handling.

capabilities.name: Error Handling and Routing
capabilities.description: Application-specific error types and exception handling for routing operations.

capabilities.name: Model Representation
capabilities.description: Core data structures and identification keys for AI models across the application.

design_decisions: Integrates Pydantic AI as a core provider backend while wrapping its primitives in standardized application abstractions and result types.
Encapsulates execution parameters, policies, and streaming/generation outcomes into dedicated modules to separate runtime control from model providers.
usage_guidance: Use the pydantic_ai provider module to initialize model registries, create agents, and configure Google API integrations.
Leverage the execution environment components to pass contexts, parameters, and policies for text generation, object generation, streaming, and embeddings.
Define AI tools and handle results using the designated tool and error structures provided by the package.
